components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for form submissions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">บันทึกข้อมูล</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #4338ca; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: The container for all main content sections.
components.html: การเงินวันนี้
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 2rem; border: 1px solid #f1f5f9; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); }

components.name: Data Input
components.description: Standard text or number input field.
components.css: .ds-input { background-color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: ring 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge (Income)
components.css: .ds-badge-success { background-color: #ecfdf5; color: #10b981; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: A financial management interface designed for clarity, speed, and accuracy. The system uses a high-contrast Indigo theme to convey professional trust, balanced with soft Slate neutrals to keep the focus on financial data.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo Authority: Deep indigo surfaces provide structure and hierarchy.
Color-Coded Feedback: Semantic use of Emerald (Income) and Rose (Expense).

rules.name: The Semantic Meaning Rule
rules.body: Color is never used decoratively. If a text or icon is Emerald, it MUST relate to 'Income' or 'Success'.

rules.name: The Flat-Surface Rule
rules.body: All data containers remain flat at rest. Elevation is only applied to interactive components or prioritized surfaces.

dos: Do use rounded-xl for all primary containers and buttons.
Do maintain a minimum of 2rem padding in main content cards.
donts: Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards.
